title: Sour Filipino Pork Skewers
description: A sour and light Filipino dish featuring mirin and lacquer glaze, perfect for a midnight craving, and friendly for those who dislike onion and garlic
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together mirin, fish sauce, calamansi juice, lacquer glaze, brown sugar, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the pork pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Soak the bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes before grilling.
Preheat a grill to medium high heat.
Thread 2-3 pieces of marinated pork onto each skewer.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot with additional calamansi juice on the side if desired.
